entries.source: #Target# defiantly reasserts %s connection to nature!
entries.target: #Target#倔强地重新确立了%s那份与自然的联系！

entries.source: Plaguefire detonates when its victim dies, spreading to other enemies up to two times.
entries.target: 瘟疫之焰感染的生物死亡时，瘟疫之焰会爆炸并传播到附近的敌人，至多传播2次。

entries.source:
You draw power from the depths of the void causing your Reality Fracture to enhance any existing rifts.
#GREY#Void Rift:#LAST# Deals %d%% increased damage and projectiles explode in radius 1.
#PURPLE#Nether Breach:#LAST# Deals %d%% increased damage and chains to 3 targets.
#PURPLE#Temporal Vortex:#LAST# Deals %d%% increased damage, radius increased by 1, and slow increased to 50%%.
#PURPLE#Dimensional Gate:#LAST# Voidling Skitterers will be frenzied, increasing their global speed by %d%%.
entries.target:
你从虚空深处汲取能量，每当你激活实境撕裂时，会自动强化你已有的裂隙。
#GREY#虚空裂隙：#LAST# 造成 %d%% 额外伤害，并且投射物在半径 1 范围内爆炸。
#PURPLE#彼世裂隙：#LAST# 造成 %d%% 额外伤害，并且连锁至 3 个额外目标。
#PURPLE#时空漩涡：#LAST# 造成 %d%% 额外伤害，效果半径增加 1，并且减速效果提高至 50%%。
#PURPLE#维度之门：#LAST# 虚空疾行者将会变得狂暴，增加他们 %d%% 的全局速度。

entries.source: #Target#'s is no longer wasting away.
entries.target: #Target#不再衰竭。

entries.source: There are creatures that could be watching you; you cannot take the risk of teleporting to Kroshkkur.
entries.target: 周围有生物可能在注视你，你不能冒险在这个时候传送至克诺什库尔。

entries.source: %d%% chance to stun any foes hit.
entries.target: 每回合首次对存活且可被震慑的敌人造成伤害时触发震慑，后续有 %d%% 几率触发，每个目标每回合限一次。

entries.source: Reduces all damage taken by %d%%.
entries.target: 降低所有受到的伤害 %d%%。

entries.source: shock grenade
entries.target: 电击榴弹

entries.source: This antique spyglass is weathered from use, but seems well maintained.
entries.target: 这具古老的小型望远镜因长年使用而饱经磨损，但看起来保养得很好。

entries.source: You see flecks of gold in this vile mass of twisted steel, implying a once great origin. Whatever glory it once had is long gone, replaced by something far more sinister...
entries.target: 你在这团扭曲的邪恶钢铁中看到点点金色，暗示着它曾有过伟大的来历。无论它昔日有过怎样的荣光，如今都已荡然无存，取而代之的是某种远为险恶的东西……

entries.source: %s toxic shell
entries.target: %s 毒性弹

entries.source: %s fatal attractor
entries.target: %s 致命诱饵装置

entries.source: Deals high light damage and increases critical multiplier.
entries.target: 造成大量光系伤害，增加暴击系数。

entries.source: #Source# lands in a #LIGHT_RED#firey explosion#LAST#!
entries.target: #Source#在#LIGHT_RED#火焰爆炸#LAST#中落地！

entries.source: deal cold damage equal to 100 + the higher of your steam or spellpower, and attempt to freeze the target (20% chance).
entries.target: 造成100+蒸汽强度或法术强度较高项的寒冷伤害，并有20%几率尝试冰冻目标。

entries.source: "Have you ever looked at some guys and thought 'you know, I really wish they were on fire right now', but you didn't feel like walking all the way over there? Well, there's now a better way!"
entries.target: “你有没有看着某些家伙，心想‘说真的，我真希望他们现在就着起火来’，却又懒得大老远走过去？那么，现在有更好的办法了！”

entries.source: Dreamweaver
entries.target: 梦境编织者

entries.source: A linen pouch of jagged mindstar fragments, each radiating a palpable sense of confusion and pain. They must have made up an impressive whole originally, before some cretin turned it to bits.
entries.target: 一个亚麻布袋中装着锯齿状的灵晶碎片，让人清晰地感受到混乱和痛苦。在某个混蛋把它打成碎片之前，它一定是一个令人惊叹的整体。

entries.source: This cloak seems to incorporate a series of blades attached to various spring mechanisms.  Apparently the designer believed that the best defense was an active one.
entries.target: 这件披风似乎装着一系列连在各种弹簧机关上的刀刃。显然制作者认为“最好的防御就是进攻”。

entries.source: cleanse up to 3 poisons or wounds detrimental effects
entries.target: 清除最多3个毒素或伤口负面效果。

entries.source: A gun sure to turn all to ash. As long as its nearby.
entries.target: 一把定能把一切化为灰烬的枪——只要目标离得够近。

entries.source: A hypospray full of ...something. There is no telling what you're injecting yourself with.
entries.target: 一个无针注射器，里面装满了……某种东西。你完全不知道你给自己注射了什么。

entries.source: Deflector
entries.target: 偏转器

entries.source: The discovery of rockets has proved incredibly dangerous. It is not always clear for whom.
entries.target: 火箭的发明已被证明极其危险——只是对谁危险，并不总是那么清楚。

entries.source: This cloak hides and protects a series of powerful steam compressors.
entries.target: 这件披风隐藏并保护着一套强力蒸汽压缩机。

entries.source: generate a personal shield that absorbs up to %d damage and damages attackers striking the wearer for %d fire damage while it lasts (based on Cunning)
entries.target: 产生护盾，吸收至多%d伤害；护盾持续期间，近战攻击穿戴者的敌人会受到%d火焰伤害（基于灵巧值）

entries.source: may infect the target with a random disease
entries.target: 可能使目标感染一种随机疾病

entries.source:
The experiment of a mad chronomancer, this strange device is a portal into a backwards universe!
That is, everything there spins the opposite direction.
I guess it probably grinds things pretty well.
entries.target:
这是一个疯狂的时空法师的实验，这个奇怪的装置是进入反向宇宙的入口！
也就是说，那里的一切都朝相反的方向旋转。
我猜它绞碎东西的效果应该相当不错。

entries.source: 5 turns after use, mirror yourself across the map (centered around the location you were standing when activated).
entries.target: 使用后5回合，将自己镜像传送到对侧（以激活时所站的位置为中心）。

entries.source: Dethzaw
entries.target: 死亡链锯

entries.source: deal a melee attack against all other enemies in a circle around you
entries.target: 对周围一圈的其他敌人进行近战攻击。

entries.source: Laser Powered Giant Smasher
entries.target: 激光驱动巨人粉碎器

entries.source: The Laser Powered Giant Smasher, nicknamed the Gloryhammer. You can feel it vibrating with untold power in your hands.
entries.target: 激光驱动巨人粉碎器，绰号“光荣之锤”。你能感觉到它在你的手中以无穷的力量震动。

entries.source: #PURPLE#You feel the power of the Gloryhammer course through you! It has become fully empowered!
entries.target: #PURPLE#你感受到光荣之锤的力量涌遍全身！它已获得完全强化！

entries.source: Create a distortion at the target tile, knocking back all projectiles and changing their direction to face away if possible.
entries.target: 在目标地块制造一处扭曲，击退所有抛射物，并尽可能使它们转向外侧。

entries.source: mirror wall
entries.target: 反射镜墙

entries.source: Creates a wall %d units long for %d turns, reflecting all projectiles that hit it and blocking sight.
entries.target: 创造一堵长度为 %d 的墙，持续 %d 回合，反射所有击中此墙的抛射物并且阻挡视线。

entries.source: Target a projectile in mid-flight to clone it and target that projectile independently. You gain ownership over the new projectile.
entries.target: 选择一个飞行中的抛射物，复制它，并指定新抛射物的目标。你获得新抛射物的所有权。

entries.source: Summons the starscape in the surrounding area in a radius of %d. For %d turns, this area exists outside normal time, and in zero gravity. In addition to the effects of zero gravity, Movement of projectiles and other creatures is three times as slow. Spells and attacks cannot escape the radius until the effect ends.
entries.target: 在周围半径 %d 的区域内召唤一片星界领域。 %d 回合内，这个区域存在于正常时间之外，且重力为零。除了零重力之外，抛射物和其他生物的移动速度降为平时的 1/3。法术和攻击在效果结束前无法离开该范围。

entries.source: @Source@ rockets forward!
entries.target: @Source@借助火箭向前突进！

entries.source: @Source@ rockets forward!
entries.target: @Source@借助火箭向前突进！

entries.source:
When you deactivate Vaporous Step, if the psychoport succeeds you inhale some of the vapours, regenerating %d steam and %d life.
		The effects will be multiplied by 33%% (diminutive) for each charge of Vaporous Step.
		The healing done will increase with your Mindpower.
entries.target:
当你解除蒸汽步时，如果精神传送成功，你会吸入部分蒸汽，回复 %d 点蒸汽与 %d 点生命。
		蒸汽步每有一层充能，效果就会提高 33%%（逐层递减）。
		治疗量随精神强度提高。

entries.source:
You imbue a steamsaw with arcane and temporal forces, making it spin very fast around your waist (ignoring requirements).
		The saw spins so fast it it disturbs spacetime around you, increasing your spellpower by up to %d, your spell critical chance by up to %d and your mana regen by up to %0.1f (depending on steamsaw tier).
		Any successful melee attack against you also triggers an automatic steamsaw attack that cannot miss dealing %d%% weapon damage as occult damage (arcane and temporal).
		The steamsaw used will provide its bonus as if it was worn, but you can not Block with it.
		Increases steamsaws weapon damage by %d%% and uses Magic instead of Strength to determine their damage.
		If using Aether Avatar, all Occult Technomancy spells become usable for its duration and all occult damage becomes pure arcane.

		#{italic}#When you first learn this talent you also learn the Steamsaw tinker creation if you didn't already know it.#{normal}#
entries.target:
你把奥术和时空能量注入一把蒸汽链锯，让它绕着你的腰飞速旋转（无视装备需求）。
		这把链锯旋转的速度是那么快，它扰乱了你周围的时空。最多增加你 %d 的法术强度， %d 的法术暴击率，和 %0.1f 的法力值恢复（基于蒸汽链锯的材质等级）
		对你造成伤害的近战攻击命中时，会自动触发一次必定命中的蒸汽链锯反击，造成 %d%% 玄机（奥术和时空）武器伤害；同一攻击者每回合至多触发一次。
		使用这种方法装备的蒸汽链锯会提供与正常装备时相同的属性加成，但你不能使用它来格挡。
		增加蒸汽链锯的武器伤害 %d%%， 并在使用蒸汽链锯时用魔力值代替力量值计算伤害。
		如果你激活了以太之体，所有科技法术：玄机系的技能都可以在其持续期间使用，并且所有玄机伤害都会转化为纯净的奥术伤害。

		#{italic}#当你第一次学会这一技能的时候，如果你还没有掌握蒸汽链锯的配方，你还会同时学会这一配方。#{normal}#

entries.source:
You reach out through the aether to all creatures in sight that were slowed by Reality Breach or Congeal Time.
		For each target you create a link of arcane infused steam to it that lasts %d turns.
		Any time the target uses a talent one of your cooling down spells is reduced by 1 (prioritizing Technomancy spells).
		Each turn the link is up the target and any creature inside the link takes %0.2f occult damage.
		As long as at least one link is up, the cooldown of your Metaphasic Spin spell is set to 6 turns instead of 30.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
你通过以太触及视野内所有被现实切裂或时间凝固减速的敌人。
		你会为每个目标建立一条注入奥术能量的蒸汽链接，持续 %d 回合。
		每当目标使用技能时，你一个正在冷却的法术便会减少 1 回合冷却时间（优先选择科技法术）。
		链接存在期间，每回合目标和链接线上的所有生物都会受到 %0.2f 玄机伤害。
		只要至少有一条链接存在，相位旋转的冷却时间就会设为 6 回合，而非 30 回合。
		伤害随法术强度提高。

entries.source:
Each time a spiderbot expires it digs around, producing either a Glacial Vapour (%0.2f cold damage and doing 30%% more damage to wet targets) or Earthquake (%0.2f physical damage and 25%% chances to stun for 2 turns) of radius 1 that last for %d turns.
		Those special kinds of Glacial Vapour and Earthquake do not affect the caster.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
每当蜘蛛机器人因持续时间结束、数量超限或机器人冲撞而被移除时，它会掘地，在周围产生寒霜冰雾（造成 %0.2f 寒冷伤害，对浸湿目标额外造成 30%% 伤害）或地震（造成 %0.2f 物理伤害，有 25%% 几率震慑 2 回合），半径为 1，持续 %d 回合。
		这些特殊的寒霜冰雾和地震不会影响施法者。
		伤害随法术强度提高。

entries.source:
Command a random spiderbot to jump onto your target at ramming speed. The impact destroys the bot (possibly triggering Cryogenic Digs).
		This creates a radius %d explosion dealing %0.2f terrene damage to all creatures while also freezing them for %d turns and rendering them wet for %d turns.
		The cooldown of this spell is affected by Body of Stone.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
命令一个剩余持续时间最短的蜘蛛机器人以冲撞速度跃向目标。撞击会摧毁机器人（可能触发低温掘进）。
		这会产生半径为 %d 的爆炸，对所有生物造成 %0.2f 寒岩伤害，同时将它们冻结 %d 回合并使其浸湿 %d 回合。
		此法术的冷却时间受岩石身躯影响。
		伤害随法术强度提高。

entries.source: A flying grapple pull %s into %s!
entries.target: 飞爪将%s拉得撞上%s！

entries.source: #LIGHT_BLUE#%s's embedded restoration system activate.
entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE#%s的嵌入式回复系统启动了。

entries.source:
Explosive Steam Engine vapour now lingers for 5 turns.
		Each turn, bleeding foes inside the cloud will take %0.2f fire damage.
		Any steamtech-using creature will also regenerate %d additional steam per turn while inside the cloud.
		Damage scales with your Steampower.
		#{italic}#Modern technology at the service of burnination!#{normal}#
entries.target:
爆炸蒸汽引擎产生的蒸汽云雾现在会持续 5 回合。
		每回合云雾范围内的流血生物会受到 %0.2f 火焰伤害。
		任何使用蒸汽科技的生物在云雾中每回合额外回复 %d 蒸汽值。
		伤害受蒸汽强度加成。
		#{italic}#尝尝最新科技带来的燃烧服务吧！#{normal}#

entries.source:
Throw a tremor engine on the battlefield that will trigger after 2 turns.
		For 5 turns after triggering, it will constantly shake the ground and stun, pin, or disarm any creature in radius %d for %d turns.
		#{italic}#The ground is mere paper to you!#{normal}#
entries.target:
在战场上投掷一枚 2 回合后触发的巨震引擎。
		触发后的 5 回合内，它会持续震动地面，使半径 %d 格内除你以外的任意生物被震慑、定身或缴械 %d 回合。
		#{italic}#你脚下只是纸张，并非大地。颤抖吧！#{normal}#

entries.source:
Spin your saws wildly around you to create a wall of steamy sawteeth.
		All melee damage against you is reduced by %d%%, you have %d%% chance to evade projectiles and you can never take a blow that deals more than %d%% of your max life.
		#{italic}#Split their bones on the saws of death!#{normal}#
entries.target:
围绕自身快速旋转链锯，形成一堵由链锯齿构成的墙壁。
		你受到的所有近战伤害降低 %d%%， 有 %d%% 的概率回避投射物，并且受到的一击伤害不会超过最大生命值的 %d%%。
		#{italic}#用死亡链锯拆了他们的骨头！#{normal}#

entries.source:
You have lived through many battles, and your experience makes you a gritty veteran.
		Saw Wheels end of effect attack increased by %d%%.
		Grinding Shield lets you live below your normal limits, up to -%d life.
		Punishment has a %d%% chance to have its cooldown reduced by 1 for each effect.
		#{italic}#Domination for all!#{normal}#
entries.target:
你是一名坚毅的老兵，经历了大量战争仍然能够幸存，有着丰富的战斗经验。
		链锯轮滑效果结束时的攻击额外造成 %d%% 武器伤害。
		利齿护盾让你突破正常生命下限，生命值降至 -%d 时仍能存活。
		目标每有一个状态，惩戒都有 %d%% 的几率使冷却时间减少 1 回合。
		#{italic}#一切尽在掌控！#{normal}#

entries.source:
You can easily see the weak points in your enemy's defenses. After all, you know to look for the same flaws in your own work.
		This grants %d armour penetration and %d%% critical strike multiplier.
		At talent level 5, you can also fight stealthed and invisible creatures without penalty.
entries.target:
你能够像找到自己工作的错误一样轻易发现敌人防御的弱点。
		获得 %d 的护甲穿透和 %d%% 的暴击伤害加成。
		技能等级 5 时，能够与潜行和隐形生物自如地战斗，不受惩罚。

entries.source: Shock Grenade
entries.target: 电击榴弹

entries.source: %s seems immune to the powerful kick.
entries.target: %s似乎对强力的踢腿免疫。

entries.source:
You focus on managing your steamgun ammo for %d turns.
		While the effect lasts your attacks do not consume shots.
entries.target:
你专注于管理蒸汽枪弹药，持续 %d 回合。
		效果持续期间不消耗弹药。

entries.source:
Sweep your shockstaff, striking all enemies in a frontal arc for %d%% weapon damage as lightning and reducing their damage dealt by %d%% for 3 turns.
		If you have a shield, you will also strike them.
		While active this replaces your normal melee attack.
entries.target:
挥舞电击棒，攻击正面弧形范围内的所有敌人，造成 %d%% 闪电武器伤害，降低他们所造成的伤害 %d%%， 持续 3 回合。
		如果你装备了盾牌，你还会附加一次盾击。
		该效果持续期间会取代你的普通近战攻击。

entries.source:
You replace your steamgun and attack with a multi-barreled bolt launcher, firing deadly chemical-infused flechettes.
		
		Each attack fires twice for %d%% weapon damage as acid and generates %d steam per hit.
entries.target:
你把你的蒸汽枪替换成一具多管弩箭发射器，发射注入致命化学物质的弹矢。

		每次攻击造成两次 %d%% 酸性武器伤害，击中恢复 %d 蒸汽。

entries.source: Flechette Burst
entries.target: 弹矢爆射

entries.source: Fire two chemical flechettes, dealing %d%% weapon damage as acid and generating %d steam per hit.
entries.target: 发射两枚化学弹矢，造成 %d%% 酸性武器伤害，每次击中恢复 %d 蒸汽。

entries.source: incompatible missile launcher
entries.target: 远程投射武器不兼容

entries.source:
You build a mighty mechanical arachnid to assist you in combat. You can equip the mecharachnid with 2 steamguns, ammunition, and armor of your choice.
If your mecharachnid is dead, this will resurrect it with %d%% of its maximum life. Your mecharachnid is automatically rebuilt at full life when combat ends.
Your mecharachnid has level %d Steamgun Mastery, Combat Accuracy and Armor Training. The mecharachnid uses Dexterity instead of Strength to equip armor.
The mecharachnid has an inbuilt teleportation device that will recall it to you when combat ends if it is not nearby.
entries.target:
你建造一台强大的机械蜘蛛，和你并肩作战。你可以给机械蜘蛛装备 2 把蒸汽枪，弹药，以及任何你喜欢的护甲。
如果机械蜘蛛死了，这一技能会重建它，并恢复它 %d%% 的最大生命值。你的机械蜘蛛会在战斗结束后自动重建，恢复全部生命值。
你的机械蜘蛛获得 %d 级蒸汽枪掌握、强化命中和重甲训练技能。机械蜘蛛使用敏捷代替力量装备护甲。
机械蜘蛛带有一个内置的传送装置，如果在战斗结束后它不在你的附近，会自动传送到你的身边。

entries.source: fatal attractor
entries.target: 致命诱饵

entries.source:
You activate hidden springs to project a saw towards your foes.
		Any creature caught in the beam takes %0.2f physical damage and bleeds for half more in 5 turns.
		The damage increases with your Steampower.
entries.target:
你启动隐藏的弹簧，向敌人射出一片锯刃。
锯刃直线路径上的任何生物都会受到 %0.2f 点物理伤害，并在 5 回合内额外受到相当于一半伤害的流血伤害。

entries.source:
You fire a special hook shot with your steamgun(s) at a target creature or location.
		If you target a creature, they are pulled up to %d tiles towards you.
		If you target an empty tile, you are pulled up to %d tiles towards it.
		This talent does not use ammo as it is the ammo.

		如果你的目标是一个空地，你会被拉向空地最多 %d 格。

entries.source:
Set up some cunning contingency plans in case of death.
		If you die you will have the option to raise back from the dead once, by becoming a ghoul or a skeleton (you can choose which).
		When rising this way you will keep access to your racial tree and gain access to the ghoul or skeleton racial tree with 2 levels of each talents already learnt.
		As undead will not able to use infusions anymore.
		If you choose to become a skeleton, the Re-assemble talent will consider that you already used your resurrection.
entries.target:
准备一个应对死亡的应急方案。
		如果你死了，你可以选择从死亡中归来一次，方式是成为骷髅或食尸鬼（由你选择）。
		以这种方式复活时，你会保留原有的种族技能树，并获得食尸鬼或骷髅的种族技能树，其中每项技能均已习得 2 级。
		成为不死族后，你将无法再使用纹身。
		如果选择成为骷髅，重组技能会视为你已经使用过一次复活。
